findings.before: Ending a session during upload started one stale decode.
findings.after: Generation guard prevents the decode from being enqueued.

findings.before: API docs promised local provider and zero cost for all model types.
findings.after: Document local versus explicitly configured cloud fields and provisional attachment ownership.

findings.before: Installer had no recorded owner and an interrupted install blocked retries.
findings.after: Unique PID owner entries reject live contenders, reclaim dead owners safely, terminate owned subprocesses on signals, and publish readiness only after decoding succeeds.

findings.before: Cloud override under a local configuration incorrectly reported missing credentials.
findings.after: Local configuration explicitly rejects cloud overrides and explains selecting a cloud model in Settings first.

findings.before: Blank and non-string preview language values overrode the Hindi preference.
findings.after: Preview and attachment language normalization match.

findings.before: An explicit cloud selection displayed the first local enum choice.
findings.after: The current saved value remains visible in enum options.

validation: Focused failing regressions reproduced before repairs; the same assertions passed after repairs. Final build/typecheck, integration tests and CI validate the combined patch. Local ledger contains per-finding red/green TAP logs; it is collaborator evidence, not a tamper-proof audit.

findings.fix: Retain the lock until tracked child close events, reject new subprocess launches during shutdown, and preserve signal exit status.
Use the stable Releases page during publication.
Normalize the legacy model slug before single-model gating.
Distinguish known zero local cost from unknown cloud estimates.
Keep local mode choices and provide an explicit custom provider entry in both interfaces.
